changes: New style Tradicional (CLASSIC): the original Lumen — neutral, opaque, accent only on details.
Accent colours grouped as Ecclesiastical / Other colours (10 swatches) plus a custom colour wheel; ink adjusted for 4.5:1 contrast in every style.
Four new Bible courses (M8): Jesus and the Paschal Mystery, Salvation History, The Psalms, Saint Paul (T-022, T-023, T-024).
Psalm references in courses use Hebrew numbering and resolve correctly in Vulgate-numbered bundled Bibles; labels show both numbers (e.g. Ps 22 (21)).
Devotion detail pages show their own image (68 images, mostly Wikimedia Commons) with a visible credit line.
known_limitations: Not tested on a physical phone.
Two images have unclear rights (Ocotlán: user-supplied; Cristo Sentenciado: reference image) and are labelled as such.
Christ devotions T-019 still pending corrections.
